hooks.command:
c=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // """); case "$c" in *"git push"*) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)}"; if command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1; then R="ruff"; else R="poetry run ruff"; fi; o=$($R format --check . 2>&1) && o2=$($R check . 2>&1) || { printf "Push blocked: ruff checks failed — fix before pushing.
%s
%s
" "$o" "$o2" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac
